description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: A global network of accelerator programs transforming innovative ideas and products into world-class companies. The Zone Startups Method Screen companies, accepting approximately 1% of applicants. Help companies grow and scale. Focus on market validation and customer acquisition. Provide seed capital to the highest potential companies. Grow companies through a Series A raise. We were at the point where we were figuring out exactly what we needed to do to scale the business quickly. During our stay, we grew the team from 2 to 13, raised $1-million and grew our client base to 75 clients. Zone Startups has given so much to us in a short span of time, in terms of space to work which brought discipline in the work style, connection among industry leaders, investors, and government officials. This discipline gave a boost to our revenues and confidence as well. Zone Startups acts as the rudder to steer our team down the wild white water ride that is a startup. Dangers lurk at any moment during the first two years and the professional and engaged Zone Startups Calgary team is there to help us avoid the pitfalls and move quickly toward success. Operating from a startup hub has given us the best exposure possible. After coming to Zone Startups, we expanded our team from 2 to 7 and are still growing.
